prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
For a **small business with a physical location or service area**, I’d start with **BrightLocal’s Local AI Visibility Checker**. It gives you a free, one-time snapshot of how ChatGPT or Google AI Mode responds to prompts you choose, including which local competitors appear. If you want ongoing tracking, BrightLocal’s paid tracker monitors prompts across ChatGPT and Google’s AI results.

If you’re **not a local business** or want to track several AI platforms, **Otterly.AI** is a reasonable low-cost option; its entry plan is listed at about **$29/month** and covers multiple engines.

One caveat: these tools sample answers to selected prompts—they can’t guarantee what every customer will see. Try realistic questions people might ask, such as “best [service] in [town],” and check results repeatedly over time.

Sources: [BrightLocal free checker](https://www.brightlocal.com/free-local-seo-tools/local-ai-visibility-checker/), [BrightLocal tracker](https://www.brightlocal.com/local-seo-tools/local-ai-visibility/), [Otterly.AI pricing overview](https://gracker.ai/blog/15-best-ai-search-monitoring-tools).
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
